name: DefaultPlatformRestrictions
label: Set Default Platform Restrictions
helpText: Sets the default enrollment platform restrictions, controlling which device platforms may enroll, whether personally-owned devices of each platform are allowed, and the minimum/maximum OS version each platform may enroll with.
executiveText: Controls which kinds of device can enrol into management, whether employees may enrol personal devices, and how up to date a device's operating system must be to enrol. This keeps unmanaged, unsupported or out-of-date platforms off corporate resources.
docsDescription: Sets the default device enrollment platform restrictions for Android, Android for Work, iOS, macOS and Windows, including optional minimum and maximum OS version limits per platform.

osMinimumVersionAndroidForWork.label: Android (work profile) minimum OS version
osMinimumVersionAndroidForWork.helperText: Example: 11.0. Leave blank to not enforce a minimum.

osMaximumVersionAndroidForWork.label: Android (work profile) maximum OS version
osMaximumVersionAndroidForWork.helperText: Example: 14.0. Leave blank to not enforce a maximum.

osMinimumVersionAndroid.label: Android (device administrator) minimum OS version
osMinimumVersionAndroid.helperText: Example: 10.0. Leave blank to not enforce a minimum.

osMaximumVersionAndroid.label: Android (device administrator) maximum OS version
osMaximumVersionAndroid.helperText: Example: 13.0. Leave blank to not enforce a maximum.

osMinimumVersioniOS.label: iOS/iPadOS minimum OS version
osMinimumVersioniOS.helperText: Example: 16.1. Leave blank to not enforce a minimum.

osMaximumVersioniOS.label: iOS/iPadOS maximum OS version
osMaximumVersioniOS.helperText: Example: 18.0. Leave blank to not enforce a maximum.

osMinimumVersionWindows.label: Windows minimum OS version
osMinimumVersionWindows.helperText: Example: 10.0.19045.0. Leave blank to not enforce a minimum.

osMaximumVersionWindows.label: Windows maximum OS version
osMaximumVersionWindows.helperText: Example: 10.0.22631.0. Leave blank to not enforce a maximum.
